prompts.poses: Three isolated full-body watercolor chibi Jordan poses on pure magenta #FF00FF matching jordan-model-sheet-v1: cheer, shock, sit. No ground shadow, no text, no floating icons.

postProcessing.key: #FF00FF border flood plus enclosed holes (--holes, 18% fuzz, edge despill only)
postProcessing.despill: despill-edge.ts magenta edge-only despill (band 12 pre-resize and post-resize)
postProcessing.atlas: 3 columns x 1 row alpha-WebP companion atlas (public/assets/characters/jordan/jordan-poses.webp + .json)
postProcessing.review: art/review/e2-jordan-poses-cream.jpg and art/review/e2-jordan-poses-dark.jpg (with base down_idle_01 in slot 0)
